scope: Uninterpreted separate native-storage and business-key domains. Truthful original-key projection preserves logical equality selection and invariance under unrelated storage identity changes. Distinct storage IDs alone impose no business-key uniqueness; an unqualified storage-ID cast can select the wrong original key. Uniqueness requires a separately qualified selected namespace/key constraint. This establishes correspondence obligations, not a JSON/row codec, compiler projection, original catalog authentication, native namespace uniqueness, actual graph implementation or backend acceptance.
